title: Unreachable true-branch in SCENARIO_EXPANDER outputs merge (`if outputs is None`)
description: In `overlay_declared_contract`, the SCENARIO_EXPANDER output-merge guard is entered only when `builder.outputs is not None`. By that point `outputs` was assigned `declared.outputs if declared.outputs is not None else builder.outputs`, so when `builder.outputs is not None` the else-branch already guarantees `outputs is not None` (it falls back to the non-None `builder.outputs`). Therefore inside the guard `outputs is None` can never be true, making the ternary's consequent `builder.outputs` dead. The expression only ever evaluates the else-branch `outputs | builder.outputs`. The branch is a behavior-preserving no-op that can be simplified to `outputs = outputs | builder.outputs`.
evidence:
Line 596-599:
  inputs = declared.inputs if declared.inputs is not None else builder.inputs  # (596)
  outputs = declared.outputs if declared.outputs is not None else builder.outputs  # (597)
  if node.data.nodeType == NodeType.SCENARIO_EXPANDER and builder.outputs is not None:  # (598)
      outputs = builder.outputs if outputs is None else outputs | builder.outputs  # (599)
Trace: entering 598 requires builder.outputs is not None. Two cases for `outputs` from line 597: (a) declared.outputs is not None -> outputs = declared.outputs (a frozenset, not None); (b) declared.outputs is None -> outputs = builder.outputs which is not None here. In both cases `outputs is None` is False, so the `builder.outputs` consequent at line 599 is unreachable. (The early-return path in `_empty_declared_contract_should_defer_to_builder` (614-615) handles the empty-declared SCENARIO_EXPANDER case before line 598 is reached, so it cannot make `outputs` None either.)
est_reduction: ~1 line / one dead conditional arm; replace ternary with `outputs = outputs | builder.outputs`.
behavior_preservation: The dead consequent is `builder.outputs`; the live arm is `outputs | builder.outputs`. Since `outputs is None` is provably never true inside the guard, the observable result is unchanged for all inputs. Removing the unreachable arm preserves behavior exactly.
